details: A producer-written two-agent handoff manifest excludes its exact live predecessor and reserves a distinct replacement run.
A primary pane that still reports its agent TUI keeps the predecessor conflict fail-closed.
Malformed handoff evidence cannot bypass the ordinary workspace conflict.
A second live owner of the same workspace still blocks replacement even when the predecessor attestation is valid.
The first sandboxed run reached the loopback proxy integration and failed with EADDRINUSE because local listen was unavailable.
The complete repository suite then passed with zero failures when temporary loopback binding was allowed.

live_incident.safety_state: No replacement launched and no teardown occurred; the old run, helpers, exact bundles, manifest, and continuation remain preserved.

known_limitations: This source evaluation does not authorize installation, a live retry, or old-run teardown of the new candidate.
